---
title: "Mentoring"
---

I enjoy supervising and mentoring students at different stages of their careers in remote sensing, plant pathology and data science. If you are interested in doing your Bachelor's, Master's or PhD thesis with me, feel free to [get in touch](mailto:rcalderon@ias.csic.es).
